chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the salat of al-Adha and al-Fitr, and he said:
"Pray them as two rak'ahs, in congregation or otherwise than in congregation, and say takbir seven times and five times."

key_terms.الْأَضْحَى: Eid al-Adha, the festival of sacrifice
key_terms.الْفِطْرِ: Eid al-Fitr, the festival marking the end of fasting
key_terms.جَمَاعَةٍ: congregation, praying collectively behind an Imam
key_terms.خَمْسًا: five times, referring to the takbirs
key_terms.سَبْعًا: seven times, referring to the takbirs
key_terms.كَبِّرْ: say the takbir, declaring Allahu Akbar

ai.seo_question: How should the Eid al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr prayers be performed according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the ruling for the salat of Eid al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that each is prayed as two rak'ahs, whether in congregation or individually, with seven takbirs and five takbirs.
